description: Per-character cursed-energy level thresholds and recovery tuning for the level gauge and the consumable cursed-energy pool.

Id.simple: Character ID used as the row key.
Id.technical: Unreal DataTable row name. ResolveDataRows selects CharacterCursedEnergyDataTable by CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterCursedEnergy or its studio override and requires the row to exist; status initialization then reads the row through AGameCharacter.CursedEnergyRow. The export has 36 rows.

LevelThreshold.simple: Ordered gauge amounts that define cursed-energy levels 1, 2, 3 and 4.
LevelThreshold.technical: TArray<float>, typically four entries (CP_010 exports 100/200/300/400). Level is the count of thresholds <= the gauge, minimum 1; index 0 is the initial floor and the last usable index is CursedEnergyLevelMax from status setup. SetCursedEnergyGauge clamps the gauge between Threshold[0] and Threshold[CursedEnergyLevelMax]. Initialization copies the array and converts it to per-level deltas for UI markers; helpers return Threshold[Level - 1] or 0 for an invalid index. Some code reads fixed indices 0 and 3 (GetLastLevelThreshold), so a shorter array is unsafe in those paths.

Recover_Wait.simple: Pause before the cursed-energy pool starts regenerating after it drops.
Recover_Wait.technical: Seconds. SetCursedEnergy (when the new value is lower) and level-up handling set CursedEnergyRecoverWait to Recover_Wait multiplied by the solo rate when applicable, and additionally by GetStatusRate154 in SetCursedEnergy. Tick decrements the wait by GetActionValue112()*DeltaTime and only recovers energy when the wait is no longer > 0. Constructor default 0.0f; CP_010 exports 1.5.

Recover_Speed.simple: Cursed-energy restored per second after the recover wait.
Recover_Speed.technical: Energy units/second. Tick computes GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate() * solo multiplier * Recover_Speed * DeltaTime, then adds it through SetCursedEnergy, which clamps to CursedEnergyMax. Constructor default 0.0f; CP_010 exports 75.0.

Recover_Wait_Rate_Solo.simple: Multiplier for Recover_Wait in solo play.
Recover_Wait_Rate_Solo.technical: Float multiplier. Used only when FGameCharacterStatusSetup.SoloSide == 1: level-up recalculation applies it directly, while SetCursedEnergy applies StatusRate154 * Recover_Wait_Rate_Solo * Recover_Wait. CP_010 exports 1.0 (no change); constructor default 0.0f, which would shorten the wait to zero if a row omitted it.

Recover_Speed_Rate_Solo.simple: Multiplier for Recover_Speed in solo play.
Recover_Speed_Rate_Solo.technical: Float multiplier applied when SoloSide == 1 in the tick recovery formula; non-solo uses 1.0. CP_010 exports 1.0; constructor default 0.0f, which would disable regeneration if a row omitted it.

Add_Rate_Solo.simple: Solo multiplier for cursed-energy gain; no consumer was identifiable.
Add_Rate_Solo.technical: Float at row offset 0x30, exported as 1.0 on all 36 rows with constructor default 0.0f. No direct or copied read of Add_Rate_Solo exists in the available Source/Plugins; AddCursedEnergyExp instead takes an externally computed Exp value. The retail field offset is corroborated by Tools/verify layout checks, but current source behavior cannot establish its exact formula.

notes: Two distinct pools share these settings: CursedEnergyGauge (level thresholds) and CursedEnergy (spendable pool clamped to CursedEnergyMax). LevelThreshold controls both the level count and the pool cap.
No localized variants of the table were exported; 36 rows were available, so variant-specific values cannot be asserted beyond the export.
Add_Rate_Solo is a serialized/validated field with no identified consumer in this source snapshot; its purpose is not inferred from its name alone.
Behavior is described from reconstructed C++; status comments with retail RVAs are not byte-match claims.

usages.detail: Resolves the required row from CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterCursedEnergy (or studio override) and caches it as AGameCharacter.CursedEnergyRow.
Initializes gauge and energy from Threshold[0]; later reads CursedEnergyRow throughout status handling.
Copies LevelThreshold into LevelThresholdDeltas and converts it to differences for display.
Clamps the level gauge to the first threshold and the CursedEnergyLevelMax threshold.
Recalculates the recovery wait on level-up, applying the solo multiplier in solo mode.
Recalculates the recovery wait when energy drops, including status-rate and solo multipliers.
Applies Recover_Speed and Recover_Speed_Rate_Solo each tick once the wait expires.
Uses GetCursedEnergyLevelThreshold to refill tag-combo performers to their clamped level's threshold.
Safe LevelThreshold[Level - 1] accessor used by effect-level logic; returns 0 for a null row or bad index.
Turns LevelThreshold entries into integer deltas for command-list gauge markers.
Copies LevelThreshold into the versus-enemy interval character gauge widget.
